_about: Public-domain Abraham Booth (1734-1806, Particular Baptist minister of Prescot Street, London) for the Word Hoard: The Reign of Grace (Hartford, 1814, from the second London edition), Glad Tidings to Perishing Sinners (Philadelphia, 1797) and Paedobaptism Examined (3 vols, London: Ebenezer Palmer, 1829), raw Internet Archive OCR (long s in the 1797 printing). Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 12 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
